script:
REPO=$(control-agent-server fixture git-repo --name qa-f16-repo --print-path) WT=$(control-agent-server conversation start --no-run --tools none --no-autotitle --workspace "$REPO" --body-json '{"worktree": true}' --print-id) WTD=$(control-agent-server api GET "/$WT" --field workspace.working_dir) test "$WTD" != "$REPO" && test -f "$WTD/README.md" && test -f "$REPO/notes.txt" printf '

qa-f16-wt

\n' > "$WTD/qa-f16-wt.html" control-agent-server api GET "/$WT/workspace/qa-f16-wt.html" --expect 200 --check . contains qa-f16-wt --save F16.worktree-served/worktree-file git -C "$REPO" show HEAD:README.md > "$F/readme-head.md" if cmp -s "$F/readme-head.md" "$REPO/README.md"; then false; fi control-agent-server api GET "/$WT/workspace/README.md" --expect 200 --raw-out "$F/readme-served.md" --save F16.worktree-served/committed cmp "$F/readme-served.md" "$F/readme-head.md" control-agent-server api GET "/$WT/workspace/notes.txt" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'File not found' --save F16.worktree-served/untracked
